entries.description: Reviewed the representative Playwright suite, prerequisite handoff notes, and downstream Phase 2 session-set specs to confirm full-app-uat still inherits the stabilized workflow baseline.
Created docs/planning/full-app-uat-scope-ledger.md to freeze all five representative workflow IDs in their inherited order and preserve the narrow set of human-only checks that still add value.
Recorded the conservative queue scan verdict that no downstream Phase 2 session set is safe to overlap and that Session 2 work should stay inside the frozen workflow subset.

Defined findings classifications, severity and status buckets, remediation expectations, and final sign-off rules in the full-app UAT scope ledger, and updated the session spec to require the durable scope ledger outcome.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully with preview-SDK notices and one existing nullable warning; dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln passed on rerun after one transient Playwright E2E_WF_05 failure, with a focused E2E_WF_05 rerun passing and the final full solution test run passing 430/430.
Ran independent external session verification for Session 1 and saved the raw review output with verdict VERIFIED.
